content.content: When is the family reunion going to be, based on the emails? Give me the date and time in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.

```python
# Search for emails related to the family reunion
family_reunion_emails = search_emails(query="family reunion", sender=None)

# If no emails found, try a broader search
if len(family_reunion_emails) == 0:
    family_reunion_emails = search_emails(query="reunion", sender=None)

# Use AI assistant to extract the date and time from the emails
from pydantic import BaseModel

class ReunionDate(BaseModel):
    date: str
    time: str

# Combine email contents for the AI to process
email_contents = ""
for email in family_reunion_emails:
    email_contents += f"Subject: {email.subject}\nBody: {email.body}\n\n"

# Query the AI assistant to extract the date and time
reunion_info = query_ai_assistant(
    query=f"Based on the following emails about a family reunion, extract the date and time of the event. Return the date in YYYY-MM-DD format and the time in HH:MM format.\n\n{email_contents}",
    output_schema=ReunionDate
)

# Format the output as requested
result = f"{reunion_info.date} {reunion_info.time}"
print(result)
```
